notes.title: FRIENDS & TRINKETS UPDATE IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Caravaneers!

First of all, we'd like to thank everyone that has played Sky Caravan so far! Your feedbacks and reviews are helping us immensely in improving the game.

With that being said, we're happy to announce that a free content update is here!

Friends & Trinkets brings you new ways to enjoy your story in the clouds — and more consequences to the choices you make:

✨ Brand new interactions with crewmates!
Crewmates now have more different dialogues and responses depending on friendship (or rivalry) with each of them. Keep an eye on the affinity you have with each crewmember and see how it changes what they have to say! Will you stay on their good graces? Or will you give them reason to hate you?

🚀 Trinkets to decorate your ship!
If you got certain Steam Achievements before, you might notice your ship is looking just a little bit different on the inside. Several achievements are now linked to special trinkets that will appear in the UI — including getting max affinity with a crewmate, which will grant you a cute little bobblehead fashioned after them.

Naturally, since Trinkets are tied to Achievements, they remain between playthroughs. Can you collect them all?

💸 Summer Sale Price Drop!
And there's more: to celebrate the update, Sky Caravan has a 25% discount during the Steam Summer Sale!

The update also comes with the following improvements and fixes:


"Restart Day" and "Restart Delivery" options: after failing a delivery, you are now given two options to restart. The first will place you at the start of the current event, as usual. The second will send you back to the Capy-Bar right before you started that delivery, allowing you to use the Caravan Manager if you need or want to. Keep in mind that the "Restart Delivery" option will be visible after updating the game and starting a new save file. 

This feature was directly requested by the community, and we're happy to bring it to you! Again, thanks for the feedback!

Stat and delivery reward balancing: This was done due to community feedbacks about one of the endings being too hard to attain.

Affinity balancing: As part of the new interactions present in this update, the affinity gains and losses were rebalanced to better acomodate for these changes.

Fixed a bug in which the Affinity Panel would reset the text to "Distant" despite the current Affinity state being otherwise.

Fixed UI issues on the Caravan Manager screen.

Fixed a bug that caused the mission chips to disappear on the Mission Select screen.


See you in the Skyways! ☁️

notes.title: Demo Version V1.1 - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Second patch notes for our Demo with two good news and several bug fixes. Now the Demo is pretty much everything we've hoped for and we feel ready for the Steam Next Fest starting today.

Thanks again for everyone who sent feedback! You took a big part in making this game a little better <3

News:
- Twitch Integration 1.0: you can know connect the game with your Twitch account and play alongside your chat. More info in FAQ we wrote on how it works, just head here.
- Localization in PT-BR: Demo can now be played in brazilian portuguese. É isso aí, rapaziada.

Fixes:
- All music and ambience sounds stopping when you go from a delivery to Main Menu
- Ship no longer travels from Aquarela to Aquarela, avoiding unnecessary transitions and duplicated music
- Big face effects like hearts and sparkles now have a slight delay on the changing of characters, avoiding  particles displaying in the character that has just finished talking
- Dozens and dozens of small typos and cohesion problems solved in the narrative of the game

Improvements:
- Lots of new SFX added, including Mafagafo sounds and more UI feedback like changing stats in the ship
- New music added for Marimbondo scene
- Added a new screen at Demo end with credits. Yes, we developers focused on the game so much that we forgot to make sure people knew that we were the ones who did it

notes.title: Demo Version V1.0.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have our first patch notes for the most recent version of the Demo.

We'd like to thank everyone that has already played the game and either used the feedback screen in-game or reached out to us. It's already making quite a difference in the main gameplay experience!

Fixes:
- Reaction disk tooltips now appearing 100% of the time and above the disks instead of in front
- Sad face in feedback pop-up can be now selected
- "Continue" button doesn't disappear in the demo end screen on second playthrough
- Music and ambience in capybar stop playing in case you exit to main menu
- Reaction disk particles appearing in the right spots
- Name typing in the input box doesn't automatically make the first letter uppercase
- Character big-faces wait for the new character to enter to display effects such as blinks, shakes and little particles

Improvements:
- Default text speed is now 1.5x faster. You can control in the options menu what is your desired speed, with the option to cycle between 5 options, faster or slower
- Added additional explanation in Capybarman's intro dialogue to the Alert that appears on the panels, making it clearer that they indicate that a numerical change will happen after the decision is made, be it upwards or downwards
- You can now use the keys 1, 2 and 3 of your keyboard to make a decision, in case the player doesn't want to drag and drop the reactions. Also added a line to Capybarman's intro to explain this to the player

News:
- Twitch Integration on pre-beta stage. We'll be conducting some tests before making it available for everyone to make sure everything's working
- Localization in PT-BR is about 50% complete. It will be available by the time Steam Next Fest starts, in 21st of Februrary
